name: File flow rules
description: Files/DropPlan.swift: DropAction (open, place, hand off, refuse) and DropPlan.plan, the one drop rule every app and the CLI share. Files/FileFlowCommands.swift: RecentFileEntry, the FileFlowTarget protocol an app adopts, and FileFlowCommands.specs: file.recent, file.open-recent, file.clear-recent, file.open-in and file.drop with their why-nots. Stubs from file-flow SF-1; bodies SF-5 and SF-6.
